Why did Krishna eat banana peels? As the story goes, before the great war, Krishna came to Hastinapur as a messenger of peace. Duryodhana prepared a royal feast. Gold plates. Fifty dishes.
But Krishna walked right past the palace, to the small home of Vidura, a humble minister. Vidura wasn't home. Only his wife was there. She was so overjoyed to see Krishna, she forgot everything.
She peeled bananas for him. But in her excitement, she threw the bananas away, and handed him the peels. And Krishna ate them, smiling, one by one. Wait, did nobody stop her?
Vidura came home and gasped. But Krishna said, nothing has ever tasted sweeter, because it was given with love. That's why God doesn't count what's on the plate. Comment Vidura if you agree.
